agents.name: studio
agents.description: Cross-agent studio router. Handles studio-level operations that span agents or concern the studio repo's own conventions (not the user's iOS project). See routing.yaml for the sub-command surface. Task-level work routes to /chanakya, /achilles, /argus.
reads: .claude/skills/studio/docs.html (existence check only; content not loaded into context)
CHANGELOG or release notes history (if present)
chain manifest YAML for `/studio work chain <manifest-or-name>`
gh issue / gh pr state when GitHub work is involved
gh issue list (if gh authenticated; remote call)
git status / git diff / git log when repo changes are involved
writes: GitHub issues on generic-dev-studio (scrubbed abstract patterns only)
README.md (only after a release actually ships)
none in default (dry-run); --yes deletes leftover artifacts only
release draft (chat output; user decides to tag)
studio event log (release_started, archive_completed, upload_completed, dsym_uploaded, slack_drafted, slack_sent)

modes.name: add
modes.description: Add a skill from a git URL to the studio — auto-generates a recipe, vendors the skill, and fans it out to every installed AI provider in one command.

modes.name: analyze
modes.description: Sweep a project's event-log + studio-feedback inbox to surface usage patterns. Writes a private detailed report and distills scrubbed public patterns to GH issues. Distinct from `ingest` (single input); analyze is a queue/log sweep.
writes: GitHub issues on generic-dev-studio (scrubbed abstract patterns only)

modes.name: audit
modes.description: Arc-coherence audit — three probes (A1 decision-ledger, A2 claim-evidence, A3 arc-exit) against ROADMAP.md + memory + git history. Silent when clean; emits drift findings when a phase/arc has fallen out of sync. Auto-invoked by SessionStart.

modes.name: guard
modes.description: Pre-work guard — greps git log, memory, and GitHub backlog for prior mentions before starting new work. Catches "already shipped", "already tried and failed", "issue already open" classes of error. On-demand only; not auto-invoked.
reads: gh issue list (if gh authenticated; remote call)

modes.name: help
modes.description: Open the studio documentation page in the default browser. Tier-1 mode. Triggers when the user asks "how does this work?", "show me the docs", or runs `/studio help` / `/studio-help`.
reads: .claude/skills/studio/docs.html (existence check only; content not loaded into context)

modes.name: ingest
modes.description: Studio-level ingest — inputs that concern the studio's own evolution (analysis reports from running on real projects, pattern observations, parking-lot candidates) rather than user-project feedback. Routes user-project feedback to `/chanakya ingest-*` instead.

modes.name: janitor
modes.description: Cross-project janitor — fans out sweep-janitor + fleet-cleanup across every project under ~/.dev-studio/. Reports counts/bytes per project. Default is dry-run; --yes actually deletes.
writes: none in default (dry-run); --yes deletes leftover artifacts only

modes.name: nodes
modes.description: Day-2 fleet management — list workers, add/remove/enable/disable, probe health, push manifest, manage scheduled sync. Wraps configure.sh + node-health.sh + sync-worker(s).sh; does not run bootstrap.

modes.name: release
modes.description: Draft release notes per `RELEASES.md` template, evaluate if the repo has crossed a release-worthy threshold, and update README's Mermaid timeline + Story so far when a release actually ships. Never auto-tags.
reads: CHANGELOG or release notes history (if present)
writes: release draft (chat output; user decides to tag)
README.md (only after a release actually ships)

modes.name: resume-plan
modes.description: Report where the studio's multi-session architecture arc is, and ask any pending questions the previous session left. Authoritative procedure — the thin `.claude/commands/resume-plan.md` slash command forwards to this mode.

modes.name: review
modes.description: Walk `REVIEW.md` at the repo root against the current diff. Auto-fix `block + auto-fix` tier, surface `ask` tier before changing, note `warn` tier. For the studio's own repo — not the user's iOS project (that's Argus's job).

modes.name: summary
modes.description: End-of-task / end-of-session completion report. Summarizes what was done, what changed, verification, unresolved items, user-pending actions, and the next command.
reads: git status / git diff / git log when repo changes are involved
gh issue / gh pr state when GitHub work is involved

modes.name: sync
modes.description: Re-sync all studio-managed skills to every installed AI provider. Ensures symlink farms are current after recipe changes, host installs, or drift.

modes.name: tf-push
modes.description: Studio-owned TestFlight / App Store Connect push driver. Thin wrapper over `scripts/studio-tf-push.sh`. Refuses live archive/upload without `STUDIO_TF_PUSH_LIVE=1`. Stage C of #217.
writes: studio event log (release_started, archive_completed, upload_completed, dsym_uploaded, slack_drafted, slack_sent)

modes.name: work
modes.description: Autonomous issue worker for a parallel track. Claims issues, commits them to the track branch, then opens one final reviewed PR to main with cleanup and summary.
reads: chain manifest YAML for `/studio work chain <manifest-or-name>`

agents.name: achilles
agents.description: Worker agent for the Turnip iOS codebase. Implements tasks on isolated git worktrees, self-reviews, invokes Argus pre-merge, merges locally, debriefs. See routing.yaml for the slash-command surface; full mode index in the dispatch table.
reads: <conversation-transcript>                        # session state; the mode scans recent turns for intent signals
<git-diff-HEAD>                                  # working-tree + staged changes summarized into diff_summary
plans/build-debt.yaml                          # `## Build Debt` source (Last green sha, Unverified since)
plans/index.yaml                               # post-migration task + release index for shipping-task collection
plans/index.yaml                               # post-migration task index (for Unverified-since set)
plans/releases/*.yaml                          # prior TestFlight releases for shipping-task range (schema: _shared/schemas/release.md)
plans/releases/*.yaml                          # prior releases for previous-tag lookup (schema: _shared/schemas/release.md)
writes: events/<date>.jsonl                            # emits worker_started / worker_stopped via scripts/write-event.sh
feedback-inbox/<source-project>/<ts>-<kind>-<slug>.md   # canonical studio-feedback inbox (path unchanged in Commit F; YAML emission is a later commit once the studio-feedback schema lands)
plans/briefs/<brief-id>.yaml                   # brief state transition dispatched → debriefed per _shared/state-machines/brief-lifecycle.md
plans/debriefs/<debrief-id>.yaml                 # canonical YAML debrief (schema: debrief@2.0.0, mode: direct-debrief, task_id: null, brief_id: null)
plans/debriefs/<debrief-id>.yaml               # paired release-type debrief (schema: _shared/schemas/debrief.md, mode: task — release surface)
plans/index.yaml                               # regenerated via scripts/rebuild-index.sh after artifact writes
plans/tasks/<task-id>.yaml                     # back-ref update: links.debrief + state transitions per _shared/state-machines/task-lifecycle.md
plans/tasks/<task-id>.yaml                     # back-ref update: links.release on each shipping task

modes.name: app-store
modes.description: App Store Release wrapper (`/achilles app-store`). Wraps the existing `/fullSendToAppStore` skill, captures App Store–specific data (git tag, GitHub release URL) alongside the release artifact + release debrief that bind the submission to Chanakya's task tracking.
reads: plans/index.yaml                               # post-migration task + release index for shipping-task collection
plans/releases/*.yaml                          # prior releases for previous-tag lookup (schema: _shared/schemas/release.md)
writes: plans/debriefs/<debrief-id>.yaml               # paired release-type debrief (schema: _shared/schemas/debrief.md, mode: task — release surface)
plans/tasks/<task-id>.yaml                     # back-ref update: links.release on each shipping task

modes.name: build
modes.description: Manual build verification (`/achilles build`). One command: green resets the debt counter on Chanakya's next sweep; red auto-bisects to name the breaking commit and files a P0 fix task. No brief required. Never prompts the user.
reads: plans/index.yaml                               # post-migration task index (for Unverified-since set)
plans/build-debt.yaml                          # `## Build Debt` source (Last green sha, Unverified since)

modes.name: debrief
modes.description: Direct-to-Claude debrief for work that bypassed the brief→worktree→Argus pipeline. Scans transcript + git diff, asks inline if tests are needed, emits a YAML debrief under plans/debriefs/. No brief, no worktree, no Argus, no git action.
reads: <conversation-transcript>                        # session state; the mode scans recent turns for intent signals
<git-diff-HEAD>                                  # working-tree + staged changes summarized into diff_summary
writes: plans/debriefs/<debrief-id>.yaml                 # canonical YAML debrief (schema: debrief@2.0.0, mode: direct-debrief, task_id: null, brief_id: null)

modes.name: group
modes.description: Composite group mode (`/achilles group <task-id>`). Executes the implementation task, then auto-continues with its test sub-tasks sequentially — all in one session. Phased: unit → integration → UI. Bails at the first unrecoverable failure with a partial debrief.

modes.name: next
modes.description: Composite next mode (`/achilles next [N]`). Picks and executes the highest-priority ready task without the user specifying a task ID. With N>1, prints a dispatch plan for other tabs.

modes.name: push-tf
modes.description: TestFlight Release wrapper (`/achilles push-tf`). Wraps the existing `/pushTFBuild` skill, adds pre-flight task collection and post-flight release artifact + debrief. The build workflow itself is unchanged — this mode exists to bind the release to Chanakya's task tracking.
reads: plans/releases/*.yaml                          # prior TestFlight releases for shipping-task range (schema: _shared/schemas/release.md)
writes: plans/tasks/<task-id>.yaml                     # back-ref update: links.release on each shipping task

modes.name: studio-feedback
modes.description: Studio-feedback capture from worker context. Mirrors `/chanakya studio-feedback` exactly — writes a feedback file to the canonical inbox path. Subagents emit feedback directly during task execution when they notice studio-level issues.
writes: feedback-inbox/<source-project>/<ts>-<kind>-<slug>.md   # canonical studio-feedback inbox (path unchanged in Commit F; YAML emission is a later commit once the studio-feedback schema lands)

modes.name: task
modes.description: Execution pipeline for brief-based and direct-mode work. Handles every task type (feature / bugfix / refactor / test-* / debug) via the shared Step 1–11 pipeline — size-driven build gate, mandatory Argus pre-merge, merge-lock, debrief.
writes: plans/tasks/<task-id>.yaml                     # back-ref update: links.debrief + state transitions per _shared/state-machines/task-lifecycle.md
plans/briefs/<brief-id>.yaml                   # brief state transition dispatched → debriefed per _shared/state-machines/brief-lifecycle.md
plans/index.yaml                               # regenerated via scripts/rebuild-index.sh after artifact writes

modes.name: test-suite
modes.description: Composite test-suite mode (`/achilles test-suite <unit|ui|all>`). Runs the full test suite (not individual task tests) against committed HEAD and produces a debrief that resets the corresponding debt counter on Chanakya's next sweep.

modes.name: worker
modes.description: Fleet worker mode. Turns the current session into a fleet pane — claims a slot atomically, starts a background watch loop, and spawns a fresh worker per dispatched task. The session is the operator-facing wrapper; the bash loop is the IPC primitive.
writes: events/<date>.jsonl                            # emits worker_started / worker_stopped via scripts/write-event.sh

agents.name: apollo
agents.description: iOS performance agent. Per-metric mode packs (memory/thermal/battery/cpu/network) under strict-9 evidence gating. Refuses recommendations without hard evidence.

modes.name: battery
modes.description: Diagnose → measure → propose → patch → re-measure protocol for battery / energy regressions under strict-9 evidence gating.

modes.name: cpu
modes.description: Diagnose -> measure -> attribute -> recommend -> verify protocol for CPU regressions under strict-9 evidence gating. Covers hot paths, main-thread saturation, off-CPU waits, and field CPU diagnostics.

modes.name: measure
modes.description: Capture-only mode for hard-evidence artifacts without recommending a fix. Pre-flight tool for Apollo perf briefs with empty evidence artifacts.

modes.name: memory
modes.description: Diagnose → measure → propose → patch → re-measure protocol for memory regressions under strict-9 evidence gating. Covers transient peaks, persistent growth, leaks, and OOM kills.

modes.name: network
modes.description: Diagnose -> measure -> recommend -> verify protocol for network-efficiency regressions under strict-9 evidence gating.

modes.name: profile
modes.description: Guided on-device profiling conductor. Turns intake, scenario, signpost plan, capture, artifact export, attribution, recommendation, and post-fix verification into a strict-9 session workflow.

modes.name: thermal
modes.description: Diagnose → measure → propose → patch → re-measure protocol for thermal regressions under strict-9 evidence gating. Covers sustained-load throttle, hang-under-thermal, CPU hot loops, and GPU-rooted heat.

agents.name: argus
agents.description: Reviewer agent for the Turnip iOS codebase. Two-stage review (spec-compliance then code-quality) between Achilles self-review and merge. See routing.yaml for the slash-command surface.

plans/briefs/<brief-id>.yaml                   # context only; spec matching is Stage 1's job

modes.name: code-quality

reads: plans/briefs/<brief-id>.yaml                   # context only; spec matching is Stage 1's job
events/<date>.jsonl                            # prior review events for this task
writes: events/<date>.jsonl                            # review_requested, argus_rules_skipped, review verdict events

modes.name: spec-compliance
modes.description: Stage 1 of the two-stage Argus review. Narrow check — does the diff match the brief? Nothing extra, nothing missed. Runs before code-quality. Drawn from obra/superpowers/subagent-driven-development.

modes.name: status

modes.name: sweep

modes.name: sync-slack

plans/releases/*.yaml                          # post-migration release artifacts (build numbers, TF tags)

modes.name: update
